programme.title: Bearded Buck
programme.desc: Join Jerry, Austin, and friends as they head afield for the Pennsylvania turkey opener.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: Randy, his brother, and his dad are all still in Oklahoma at the Dirty Bird ranch wrapping up rifle season.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: The boys are at the Dirty Bird in Oklahoma getting the Oklahoma turkey season kicked off.

programme.title: Realtree Road Trips
programme.desc: Rigsby Stewart and Bryan Brown journey west to finally crack the October lull. Rigsby takes his biggest buck yet with a bow.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: The team at Winchester Ammunition has arrived in Oregon to visit the Leupold Long Range Academy. There, they’ll put Winchester’s new “Supreme Long Range” ammunition to the test, pushing its performance across demanding long-range scenarios. - - With precision, consistency, and confidence on the line, the team is eager to demonstrate exactly what “Precision Rifle Perfected” means when every shot counts.

programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting
programme.desc: Mark Kayser reveals the secrets to building and positioning mock scrapes to outsmart mature bucks and orchestrate the ultimate whitetail setup.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark Peterson's South African journey continues as he moves into the historic Orange Free State. After incredible hunts in the Eastern Cape and Northern Cape, Mark is shifting his focus to two unique and challenging species: Mouflon and Feral Goat. Join Mark as he navigates the diverse terrain of the Orange Free State, putting his skills to the test in pursuit of these wary and elusive animals. Navigating the region’s expansive plateaus, Mark must rely on his glassing skills and long-range accuracy to secure these elusive trophies. This film features an 820 Yard Shot with his Gunwerks 300PRC - by far the longest shot Mark has ever done on a live animal! This is a prime testimony for Gunwerks' Long Range University.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark Peterson is in Ethiopia hunting Mountain Nyala. After the first two days, Mark has taken a Menelik’s Bushbuck and a Colobus Monkey but no Mountain Nyala. Finally, on Day 3 the hunting party receives the green light from the military to hunt in the area they wanted. It's time to put the Gunwerks rifle to the test.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We are blessed today to hunt with Cole Dutton for the Inaugural Pierce Dutton Memorial Hunt. We are honored to spend a weekend with Cole and his family at the G2 Ranch. Disabled Outdoorsman has played a huge part in getting those less fortunate outdoors. We are truly blessed to be able to follow along and capture these great moments.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: Follow TTHA President/CEO Christina Pittman and her husband Matt this week as they tag along side Dr. James Kroll for his annual deer day! This is a great opportunity to learn from one of the best. We are blessed to be able to share his knowledge with other like minded outdoor enthusiasts.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 2 of the British episodes, Andy visits the majestic land of Scotland. Here he is introduced to Scottish deer stalking, a type of hunting that is full of history and etiquette. He hunts ‘monarch’ stags and goes into the Atlantic waters to find some of the freshest shellfish on the planet which he, and Mike Robinson cook and eat. Concluding the British episodes in a place as wild as Scotland really sets the tone for the series.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Episode 2 of Hunting Land Man keeps it rolling in the Mississippi woods. We’ve got some good buddies in camp this week, and it doesn’t take long for things to get interesting. One hunt ends in a tough miss, but we stay after it and bounce back with a longbeard hitting the dirt not long after. Later in the week, Slade’s wife Lori gets her first turkey of the year in an awesome hunt that came together just right. That’s just how it goes, what turkey hunting is all about, some ups, some downs, and a whole lot of good times. Season 4 is heating up.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Slade and the crew are finally able to catch up with these elk despite some pretty terrible weather conditions. It comes right down to the wire! Don’t miss it.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, Slade and his son take on the turkey woods for an afternoon hunt. Although the woods remained quiet, a tom soon snuck out of the woods and on the end of Bentley's barrel! After that Slade was able to help a client of his harvest his first turkey! And boy was it an action packed hunt! Jakes, hens, and tons of gobbles, This hunt is spectacular! Lastly, Slade introduces a property that we have already made a video on, but with just how amazing the land is, we had to include it! Floweree is the epitome of a sportsman's paradise!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: On this episode of Hunting Land Man, Slade, Ryan and Bearcub take on the midwest! After some tough hunting, the group is able to make a move to get in position on a BIG midwestern gobbler! Bearcub was able to harvest him after working the bird for almost 45 minutes! Slade and Ryan also do some Pre-Deer season work, and establish where the fall food-plots will be!

programme.title: hunting_land_man
programme.desc: It’s Caleb’s turn to hunt and Slade gets behind the camera. They encounter their target buck, but end up getting a shot at a different buck, and it’s a big boy.

programme.title: Ship Shape TV
programme.desc: During this episode of Ship Shape TV Essentials the SSTV team is at - John’s lake house on Tupper Lake, NY. They are checking out some of the damage done to John’s pontoon decking from freezing weather they received. John and the team are upgrading the material, and adding carpeting to the pontoon decking. We also get some information on SPX-Johnson bilge pumps and the ease of access they provide.

programme.title: Ship Shape TV
programme.desc: During this episode of Ship Shape TV Essentials the SSTV team is at - John’s lake house on Tupper Lake, NY, where they are tackling a new paint Job using Interlux’s paint specifically designed for aluminum hulls. John and the crew take us step by step on what takes to paint on aluminum hulls as well as some other tips from guest hosts.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Watch as Lori tags her first turkey of the season as well as the daily grind and comments from the office in McComb, Mississippi. The ladies in the office isn’t too fond of turkey season until it’s their turn.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, Slade takes us through his new investment property, and breaks down - what’s involved in taking a raw land tract and creating extremely desirable turn-key - hunting properties. - Caleb and Slade double up on some Wilkinson County gobblers for Calebs first turkey - kill ever.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Missouri Project continues but this time it’s all about the turkey killing. Not only does Slade tag out in Missouri and Iowa, but a good family friend Kyle Hicks and Turkey Man Eddie Salter join in on a few hunts. Also, Slade does work on finding new 1031 tax properties and well as a little control burn.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Slade is staying busy busy around the house, lots of testing on summer plots with Deergro and Backwoods bachelor pad blend. Also, there locally he takes a quick look at the new 60 acres he and Ryan bought as an investment property. Then ends with a throwback hunt from under the barn.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: The "Trained Assassins" are back and it’s turkey season in the Midwest. In this first episode, Slade, Blake, and Ryan start in Missouri, run into some trouble, but end up getting it done on the first leg of the 2024 turkey tour.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: We are in Kansas again chasing monster whitetails. This season makes 15 years that we have been going to Kansas and this year was special. But first we had to show you this amazing listing in South Louisiana that’s a little different for the Hunting Land Man.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: U.S. Marine Jake Naylor recounts his harrowing service as an EOD tech in Afghanistan.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: Vietnam war veteran Tim Smith recounts his time in Vietnam and surviving a direct hit by a missile.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: Charter boat captain Mike Macko recounts his grueling life in the engine room aboard a U.S. Navy ship in the South Pacific theatre.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: U.S. Army veteran Victoria Phillips share her history of unimaginable trauma. - Viewer discretion is advised.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: Follow TTHA President/CEO Christina Pittman and her husband Matt this week as they tag along side Dr. James Kroll for his annual deer day! This is a great opportunity to learn from one of the best. We are blessed to be able to share his knowledge with other like minded outdoor enthusiasts.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: Follow TTHA President/CEO Christina Pittman and her husband Matt this week as they chase Whitetails at Morrow Ranch. This is a hunt that they had purchased earlier at the Disabled Outdoorsman in the year to be able to spend some time in the woods. A few days away to relax and spend quality time with loved ones should always be a priority. Morrow Ranch is definitely a go to place for low fence Texas hunting.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: John Sewell has played a huge part in the development of feeding Fortified Cottonseed 365 days a year. Laramie Barrett of Fortified Cottonseed joins John for a great weekend of hunting at his ranch in Uvalde, Texas. This is a great time for Laramie to get away from the office and see the first hand of how their product is performing.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: WE join Bobby Falkenberg as he joins Bret Ferguson from Double T Outfitters. Bobby is an avid outdoorsman, judge, and father of 5. Bret manages 30,000 acres in Ozona TX, the knowledge he has of every inch of this amazing low fence ranch is remarkable. Bobby has an action packed 2 day hunt.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: Each year we get to spend time in camp with some of our best friends. Zach from Big & J gets some time in a blind while reflecting on what hunting in Texas means to him. Texas provides a wide variety of game, and chasing these creatures all across the state is some of the best times had.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: This is the story of how FE Hill ranch got it's start. From its inception, FE Hill has created opportunities for people to experience the outdoors and create memories. For us, it has created a tradition of Fathers and Sons hunting together.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: This week we are rolling along side the crew from Double T Outfitters. Management plays a huge role in every outfitters success every year. Bret and his team have a strong management plan in place and these guys had a blast with a group of out of state hunters.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: The bond between and parent and child can grow in many ways, but nothing compares to the bond shared when hunting. The annual Father-Son hunt at FE Hill Outfitters has becoming a tradition for Heath and his son Gavin and in 2021, Gavin was able to take his largest buck to date, with his dad Heath behind the camera.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoor
programme.desc: Capt. Mike Avinon takes Blair off Naples for a variety of fish.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoor
programme.desc: Capt. Blair tries for an upgrade off the coast of Naples.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoor
programme.desc: Capt. Blair heads out by himself out of Cape Canaveral and gets a surprise at the end.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoor
programme.desc: The first half Blair heads out with Greggor Dornau of Starbrite Solutions, then in the second half goes fishing with Capt. Bobby lane for bass.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff venture deep into Maine’s backcountry with their buddy Chuck, ice fishing remote lakes only reachable by snowmobile. Their journey ends at the legendary “ghost trains,” a pair of abandoned locomotives that now rest as silent monuments to a forgotten logging era.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff wade into the flooded timber of the legendary Coca-Cola Woods, where mallards drop through the treetops in waves. Amidst echoes of calling and wingbeats, they experience one of America’s most iconic duck hunts.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors

As opportunities come and go, they break down how the combination of plated steel and tungsten delivers increased pellet counts, hard-hitting performance, and confidence on challenging shots. - From slow mornings to exciting evening flights, every hunt brings new lessons, memorable retrieves, and the reward of time spent in the blind. programme.title: Winchester Life

From Shadow's early days as a hunting dog to becoming a beloved part of the family, his impact reaches far beyond the field. - With each retrieve, the day becomes less about the harvest and more about celebrating a hunting partner who has given 14 years of loyalty, determination, and unforgettable memories. As Foster looks toward future hunts without Shadow by his side, one thing remains certain—the memories they made in the field will never be forgotten.

programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Marcelina visits Mother Isabel to talk to her about her relationship with Rosa Blanco, who was her best friend and who betrayed her; that is why she wants to prevent her return.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: After a phone call from Rosa Blanco to Luciano, Camila, excited, wants to talk to her mother. Captain Torrealba helps her to understand the secrets about the crime. After Sebastian is brutally attacked, Ezequiel wants to avenge her with Fernando, an Aragon.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Patricia and Maria Amelia had denounced the crime of Leoncio's death. Torrealba confronts them because he wants to know how Rosa killed Leoncio. Patricia, desperate, drinks without restraint. Faced with her lack of control, the detective, captious, doubts her.

programme.title: Marketplace
programme.desc: Canada's consumer watchdog series since 1972, this news program uncovers wrongdoings in the marketplace. With the help of hidden cameras, correspondents dish out the dirt on not so "clean" business practices. Once they get the evidence they need on tape, they apply pressure on businesses to change policies vis-a-vis the products and services they provide to the public.

programme.title: About That

programme.title: The Fifth Estate
programme.desc: The top-notch team of hosts Bob McKeown, Gillian Findlay, Mark Kelley and Habiba Nosheen provides unique and engaging documentaries from Canada and beyond. "The Fifth Estate" is a reference to the term Fourth Estate, and was chosen to highlight the program's determination to go beyond everyday news into original journalism. The series has won numerous awards for its reporting, including Gemini Awards, International Emmys, the Michener Award, and even an Academy Award for a 1981 episode that was released in theaters the following year. Since September 1975, Canadians have tuned in to experience interesting stories that are always well-crafted and thought-provoking.

programme.desc: On Halloween night in New Salem, Radio DJs Chilly Billy (Corey Taylor) and Paul (Zach Galligan) tell a twisted anthology of terrifying local myths that lead to a grim end for small-town residents.

programme.title: Hoax
programme.desc: An investigative team travels deep into the remote Colorado wilderness after a group of young campers are viciously murdered by what may be Bigfoot.

programme.title: JeruZalem
programme.desc: Two American girls on vacation follow a mysterious anthropology student on a trip to Jerusalem. The party is cut short when the trio is caught in the middle of a biblical apocalypse. Trapped between the ancient walls of the holy city, they must find a way out as the fury of hell is unleashed upon them.

programme.title: Mark of the Witch
programme.desc: On her 18th birthday, she will belong to the devil. Compelled by the idea she has an evil twin, a beautiful young woman is driven into a dark underworld of demonic possession, desire, and extreme indulgences when she learns she may be the devil's daughter.

programme.title: Red Letter Day
programme.desc: While adjusting to a new life in a quiet suburban community, a recently divorced mother and her two teens receive mysterious red letters instructing them each to kill or be killed.

programme.title: The Curse of Audrey Earnshaw
programme.desc: A devout community suffering from a plague is torn apart by a beautiful young woman and the forces of witchcraft, black magic, and possession.

programme.title: The Golem
programme.desc: During an outbreak of a deadly plague, a mystical woman must save her tight-knit Jewish community from foreign invaders, but the entity she conjures to protect them is a far greater evil.

programme.title: The Fare
programme.desc: Harris, a world-weary taxi driver, and his fare, Penny, find themselves trapped in an endlessly looping ride that changes their lives forever.

programme.title: Terrifier
programme.desc: Based on a character from the successful horror anthology franchise All Hallows’ Eve, Art The Clown returns and sets his sights on three young women, along with anyone else that gets in his way.

programme.title: Uncle Peckerhead
programme.desc: When a punk band scores their first tour, life on the road proves tough when they are joined by a man-eating demon as a roadie

programme.title: Queen of Spades
programme.desc: According to legend, an ominous entity known as the Queen of Spades can be summoned by performing an ancient ritual. Four teenagers summon the Queen of Spades, but they could never imagine the horrors that await them.

programme.title: Lasso
programme.desc: An Active Senior Tour group outing turns deadly when the crazed, bloodthirsty cowboys from a local rodeo attraction start abducting and killing people!

programme.title: Harpoon
programme.desc: Rivalries, dark secrets, and sexual tension emerge when three best friends find themselves stranded on a yacht in the middle of the ocean desperate for survival.

programme.title: Candy Corn
programme.desc: It’s Halloween weekend and a group of bullies are planning their annual hazing on local outcast, Jacob Atkins. When they take things too far, he’s resurrected to seek revenge against those that wronged him.

programme.title: Last Rampage

programme.title: Mission to the Moon
programme.desc: In the international race to the moon, the Norwegian mission is led by brilliant inventor Reodor from the village of Flaklypa. With Louis the Magpie as the brave astronaut, what could possibly go wrong? Quite a bit, actually – on the daring mission, secret passengers are discovered, hidden agendas are revealed, and nothing seems to work out the way it was planned. Louis and his friend Luca the Hedgehog are in for some surprises on their trip to the moon. The third film in the stop-motion trilogy featuring the beloved characters from the Flaklypa universe.

programme.title: Spy Cat
programme.desc: Four crazy anti-heroes, one pawsome adventure. Join special-agent Marnie and her friends as they team up and fight crime. Spoiled and innocent, chubby house cat Marnie lives a comfortable and pampered life in the Sunshine household. She has never ventured outside the family home and only knows about the real world through her favourite detective, crime TV-shows.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy Lupin manages to convince the pack elders to let him sit Howlington Academy’s entrance test. Freddy must use all his poodle wits- and his best friend Batty’s help!- to win a place at the historically wolf-only academy.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s the first day of school, and Freddy immediately comes into conflict with bully Ivan, who blackmails him into stealing the sacred moonstone! But when Batty is exposed to the moonstone, she’s turned into a human girl!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy attempts to teach Batty how to be human, while searching for a cure for her new form. A class assignment to capture the mysterious ‘Golden Horn’ and prove who the ‘alpha’ wolf is goes awry when a wilderwolf attacks!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy becomes convinced that there’s a wilderwolf at Howlington, and launches a daring investigation to prove that it’s the school accountant, Mr Sminch. Howlington gets a new teacher, the super cool and charming Ric Rawls.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids are struck down by a flea infestation, and Freddy and Batty are tasked with tracking down the mysterious Doog, keeper of the Fleaminator, the most powerful flea treatment known to dog, before they’re all expelled!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids head out on their first excursion to Night Patrol HQ. Freddy gets pulled into Scarlet’s world as she gets closer to the truth about werewolves and the two bond when they get stuck in the forest while tracking a wolf.

programme.title: Sarah Barthel on Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden sits down with Sarah Barthel—singer, songwriter, and one half of platinum duo Phantogram—for a candid conversation about using art to process emotion, the band’s obsessive pursuit of a singular sound, and the lifelong creative bond between Sarah and bandmate Josh Carter. They trace Phantogram’s beginnings (from beat tapes to breakthrough), balancing romance and partnership, channeling real-life heartbreak into “When I’m Small,” coping with family loss, and gearing up for a summer tour with Deftones. Cameos of warmth (including Leroy the dog) and plenty of shop talk on writing, producing, and performing.

programme.title: Comedian CP: Sunday After Six
programme.desc: Known for his sharp wit and fearless storytelling, Comedian CP (Detroiters, Love Life, How to Die Alone) takes the stage in Sunday After Six — a no-holds-barred stand-up special that dives into fatherhood, relationships, race, and the kind of real-life moments you couldn’t make up. From awkward encounters to wild imagination, CP’s offbeat humor and unfiltered honesty make every punchline land harder than the last.

programme.title: First Listen: Motel Du Cap – Live with Good Charlotte
programme.desc: Hear Good Charlotte's new album in full with exclusive stories, commentary, and fan Q&A. Your front-row seat to Motel Du Cap.

programme.title: Catherine Cohen: Come For Me
programme.desc: In this acclaimed one-woman show, comedian and cabaret star Catherine Cohen delivers a sharp, musical, and self-aware exploration of modern womanhood. Blending stand-up, original songs, and theatrical flair, Cohen takes the audience through her thoughts on dating, therapy, faith, and self-image — all with biting wit, charm, and glitter. Filmed live in New York City, Come For Me celebrates confidence, vulnerability, and the chaos of being thirty and thriving.

programme.title: Ice Nine Kills: I Heard They Kill Live 2
programme.desc: Watch I Heard They Kill Live 2, a live Ice Nine Kills concert film captured at Thanx-killing 2022 in Massachusetts.

programme.title: Metal From the Dirt: Rez Metal on the Navajo Nation
programme.desc: Navajo (Diné) musicians and scene builders trace the rise of Rez Metal, from generator-powered desert shows to Hogan rehearsals, blending heavy music with culture, pride, and survival.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Jon Foreman, frontman of the GRAMMY-winning rock band Switchfoot, joins Joel Madden for a thoughtful conversation on surfing, faith, creativity, and the balance between joy and discomfort. They explore themes of mindfulness, artistic purpose, and growth through challenge — diving into Jon’s new solo album In Bloom and the philosophies that guide both his music and his life.

programme.title: Lamb of God: Killadelphia
programme.desc: Lamb of God's Killadelphia showcases the thrash-metal band at The Trocadero in 2005, featuring a recorded set, candid footage, and an all-access portrait.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Entrepreneur and author Vishen Lakhiani, founder and CEO of Mindvalley, joins Joel Madden for an in-depth conversation on mindfulness, compassion, and redefining success. Together they explore meditation, conscious living, and how self-awareness and emotional intelligence can transform relationships, business, and personal growth.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: GRAMMY-winning singer-songwriter Brandon Lake joins Joel Madden to talk balancing fame and family, using music to share his relationship with faith, and previewing his upcoming album King of Hearts. He opens up about hiring a performance/health coach for life on tour, dialing in nutrition and strength training, life on a new South Carolina farm, growing up in church and learning guitar, and the joy of community in music—from a viral onstage “Higher” moment to swapping stories about Creed and meeting Scott Stapp.

programme.title: GHOST: Rite Here Rite Now - All Access Watch Party
programme.desc: GHOST’s debut film RITE HERE RITE NOW blends live performance with a narrative story. Filmed at Los Angeles' Kia Forum during the RE-IMPERATOUR tour finale.

programme.title: Fall Out Boy: So Much For (2our) Dust Live from Madison Square Garden
programme.desc: Recorded at the iconic Madison Square Garden, So Much For (2our) Dust captures Fall Out Boy delivering an electrifying performance filled with emotion, energy, and nostalgia. With a setlist that spans their entire career — from early emo anthems to their latest hits — the band’s signature blend of heartfelt lyrics and explosive showmanship takes center stage. Between songs, frontman Pete Wentz shares raw reflections on loss, creativity, and the band’s improbable journey from punk clubs to arena stardom, making this concert a powerful chronicle of endurance and connection.

programme.title: Modest Mouse: Live From Red Rocks Amphitheatre
programme.desc: Modest Mouse performs live at Red Rocks Amphitheatre, showcasing songs from The Golden Casket in a special concert event.

programme.title: Improbably Poppy
programme.desc: Poppy starts to worry her whims might have consequences and brings in a scientist and a theologist to unpack chaos theory, the butterfly effect, and free will—while she processes the futility of it all. A game-show parody (“Lucky Case Game”) goes off the rails, the house band Rodent’s Revenge keeps the chaos moving, and Poppy “liberates” her beloved plants with the gift of free will. TV-14. Fictional violence and language.

programme.title: Benji & Joel Madden / Cameron Diaz & Katherine Power: Side Hustles
programme.desc: Good Charlotte’s Benji and Joel Madden share their journey into artist management, while Cameron Diaz and Katherine Power discuss building their organic wine brand, Avaline.

programme.title: Believer
programme.desc: Dan Reynolds of Imagine Dragons investigates Mormon church's treatment of LGBTQ members. Rising suicide rates in Utah drive his concern.

programme.title: Gottmik / Mayer Hawthorne: Side Hustles
programme.desc: Gottmik launches a beauty brand, while Mayer Hawthorne shares his wine and vinyl-inspired business journey.

programme.title: Gogol Bordello: Live From Union Transfer in Philadelphia
programme.desc: Gogol Bordello bring their post-punk energy to Philly’s Union Transfer. Their explosive global punky party is on full display.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: GRAMMY-winning singer-songwriter Brandon Lake joins Joel Madden to talk balancing fame and family, using music to share his relationship with faith, and previewing his upcoming album King of Hearts. He opens up about hiring a performance/health coach for life on tour, dialing in nutrition and strength training, life on a new South Carolina farm, growing up in church and learning guitar, and the joy of community in music—from a viral onstage “Higher” moment to swapping stories about Creed and meeting Scott Stapp.

programme.title: Lost Evenings VI: Night 4 – Greatest Hits
programme.desc: Frank Turner & The Sleeping Souls close out Lost Evenings VI in Anaheim with a sold-out, career-spanning set packed with fan favorites, sing-alongs and candid moments. Highlights include “1933,” “Recovery,” “The Next Storm,” “Miranda” and “Little Changes,” capping four nights of music and celebration.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden sits down with Carly Pearce on Artist Friendly. Pearce reflects on leaving high school at 16 for Dollywood, moving to Nashville at 19, and years of grinding before her breakthrough. She opens up about trusting her instincts, turning heartbreak into Grammy-winning music, and making peace with the hardest chapters of her story.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Bobby from the British punk-rap duo Bob Vylan joins Joel Madden for an unfiltered conversation about self-determination, identity, and breaking barriers in music. Bobby opens up about growing up between London and Ipswich, navigating racism, finding purpose through education, and how his lived experiences fuel the band’s powerful, socially charged sound.

programme.title: Hey Violet: The Final Show (Live from Los Angeles)
programme.desc: Recorded live in Los Angeles, this farewell concert captures Hey Violet’s final performance together after nine years as a band. Featuring raw emotion, high energy, and fan-favorite songs, the show is a powerful celebration of their evolution from pop-punk newcomers to alternative mainstays.

programme.title: Kings of Leon: Live at The O2 London, England
programme.desc: Kings of Leon performs live at The O2 in London, delivering hits like Sex on Fire and Use Somebody in a high-energy set.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: On this week's episode of Artist Friendly, Joel Madden sits down with Paul Walter Hauser. From waiting tables to a Golden Globe, Emmy, and Critics' Choice Award for Black Bird — Paul Walter Hauser has built one of Hollywood's most distinctive careers by refusing to play it safe. Now starring in Fantastic Four and the new Resident Evil, he gets honest about fear, learning to say no, and why being his realest self matters more than chasing the next big role.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden sits down with Sam Carter, the powerhouse vocalist of Architects, for a candid conversation about gut instincts, creative integrity, and nearly two decades of building one of heavy music’s most influential bands. Sam opens up about his serendipitous bond with Good Charlotte, the “say yes or say no” mindset that guides his decisions, and how gratitude—and a little British self-deprecation—keep him grounded. He reflects on Warped Tour dreams turned stadium reality, the band’s tight-knit dynamic, and why this era is about smiling more, having fun, and bringing the wide-eyed 13-year-old version of himself back on stage. They also talk about Architects’ new album, The Sky, The Earth & All Between (out Feb 28), aiming to make their 11th record their biggest and most honest yet.

programme.title: Queen: Live at the Rainbow '74
programme.desc: Queen performs a 1974 concert at London’s Rainbow Theatre, capturing the band’s early rise with a powerful live set.

programme.title: Elevation Worship and Steven Furtick: Elevation Nights Live from Philadelphia
programme.desc: Elevation Worship and Steven Furtick perform the final stop of Elevation Nights 2024 in Philadelphia with a powerful live worship experience.

programme.title: Reggie Watts: Never Mind
programme.desc: Comedian, musician, and improvisational mastermind Reggie Watts takes the stage in Los Angeles for a performance that bends space, sound, and sense itself. Blending stand-up, music, and live looping, Never Mind explores technology, nostalgia, and the absurdity of modern life through spontaneous humor and sonic experimentation. Both futuristic and deeply human, this live special showcases Watts’ singular ability to find rhythm and meaning in chaos.

programme.title: Megadeth - Crush The World Tour Live from Buenos Aires – Night 2
programme.desc: Night two of the Megadeth two-night stand at Buenos Aires’ Movistar Arena on the Crush The World Tour. Filmed for Veeps, Night 2 delivers a blistering set of thrash classics and newer tracks, led by Dave Mustaine and fueled by the crowd’s relentless energy.

programme.title: Improbably Poppy
programme.desc: In this surreal premiere, Poppy hits the streets of Monrovia offering eerie fortunes, interviews a survivor of the Dave Matthews Band bus disaster, and encounters Archduke Franz Ferdinand in a time-warping twist. Between absurd sketches and existential reflections, she performs a musical lesson on embracing chaos and taking risks. TV-14 (fictional violence, language).

programme.title: Improbably Poppy
programme.desc: Poppy guides the puppets through a disturbingly enlightening lesson on “growing up,” from receding hairlines and miracle fixes to a viewer “gift” of unwanted pizzas that spirals into paranoia. A long-lost educational reel on second puberty resurfaces before Poppy and Joel crunch “life-or-death” fractions and Poppy closes with a bleak lullaby about adulthood. TV-14.

programme.desc: BLACK WAX is a musical-political entertainment film produced and directed by Robert Mugge. It centers on the late African American poet-singer-songwriter Gil Scott-Heron - the man Melody Maker called the most dangerous musician alive and many dubbed the forefather of rap music - and his Midnight Band.

programme.title: Marley
programme.desc: A documentary on the life, music, and legacy of Bob Marley. Produced by Ziggy Marley, this once in a lifetime piece explores the Legend's life beyond the stage, reliving his childhood, upbringing and innermost thoughts - from the people closest to him.

programme.title: LoudQUIETloud: A Film About the Pixies
programme.desc: loudQUIETloud follows the rehearsals and the warm-up shows for the full-fledged, sold-out Pixies reunion tour. It also catalogs, in the cinema-verite style of the Rolling Stones' Gimme Shelter, the less glamorous side of the touring band lifestyle, getting as close to this enigmatic act as anyone is ever likely to get. The Pixies have a once-in-a-lifetime chance at rock n roll redemption.

programme.title: Folk Metal Forest Feast
programme.desc: Raise your horns and join the battle! A high-energy mix of crushing metal riffs, accordion melodies, and epic pagan chants. Step into the ancient woods for a wild night of acoustic tradition meets heavy metal fury.

programme.title: Your Pulse Of Metal
programme.desc: Sync your heartbeat to the complex rhythms of the underground. This collection dives into technical mastery and hidden gems that push your adrenaline. If you’re ready to feel the music in your veins, we’ve got the tracks.

programme.title: Manic Ritual
programme.desc: Lose yourself in the flickering shadows of distortion. A hypnotic sequence of sonic violence and dark imagery designed to unsettle the soul. Bow to the heavy. Welcome to the Manic Ritual.

programme.title: Thrash Metal Attack
programme.desc: Pure, unadulterated speed and fury! Experience blistering shred solos, aggressive riffing, and neck-snapping rhythms. Turn up the volume and brace yourself for an unstoppable wave of high-octane thrash metal chaos!

programme.title: The Home of Heavy
programme.desc: Step into the headquarters for everything that shakes the earth. From the pillars of the classics to the pioneers of the new era, this is where the heart of metal beats loudest. This is where you belong.

programme.title: Rock Bottom
programme.desc: Found your new baseline. Rock Bottom digs deep into the rawest hard rock and alt-anthems. We’re hitting the floor with heavy riffs and soulful grit—no shovels required, just volume. This is the foundation of everything that kicks.

programme.title: Endless Heavyness
programme.desc: Dive into pure power and unrelenting energy. Endless Heavyness is a non-stop wall of sound designed to hit hard and stay loud. No pauses, no compromises—just the most massive tracks to keep the momentum going. It’s not just loud; it’s eternal.

programme.title: Wishbone Ash - Live In Hamburg
programme.desc: Ein legendärer Auftritt einer Hardrock-Legende in Hamburg! Diese Aufnahme vereint frisches Material mit zeitlosen Klassikern. Eine musikalische Reise durch mehr als dreißig Jahre Rockgeschichte, die pure Energie und Nostalgie verspricht.

programme.title: From The Scene For The Scene
programme.desc: Go beyond the music and into the heart of the underground. This collection pairs heavy-hitting videos with exclusive band interviews and reports from metal capitals worldwide. Built by the scene, for the scene.

programme.title: Black Metal Ceremony
programme.desc: Immerse yourself in darkness with this collection of raw, atmospheric black metal. From blistering tremolo riffs to unholy vocals, this playlist evokes ancient rituals and nocturnal desolation. Enter the abyss and join the ceremony.

programme.title: Alternative Metal Paths
programme.desc: Break free from tradition with heavy riffs, crushing grooves, and genre-bending experiments. This collection showcases the boldest voices bridging alt-rock, grunge, and heavy metal into unvarnished, emotionally charged anthems.

programme.title: Heavy Pumping
programme.desc: Ditch the pre-workout and let the riffs do the heavy lifting. This high-octane blast of speed and power is designed to fuel your gains or ignite a living room mosh pit. High BPMs, crushing drums, and zero excuses.

programme.title: Power Metal Journey
programme.desc: Embark on a heroic quest fueled by soaring vocals, blistering guitar solos, and triumphant symphonic melodies. This playlist delivers high-energy anthems, epic fantasy tales, and pure, unstoppable speed metal glory.

programme.title: A Tribute to Vienna
programme.desc: Chamber music ensemble The Philharmonics pays tribute to the music of Vienna from Vienna's Café Sperl; the ensemble consists of musicians from the Vienna Philharmonic and the Berlin Philharmonic.

programme.title: Orff: Carmina Burana
programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Música del Palacio de Mineria.

programme.title: Beethoven Piano Concerto No. 1 & Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: In this August 2020 concert at the Lucerne Festival, Argentine pianist Martha Argerich performs Ludwig van Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 1 in C major, Op. 15 with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra; Beethoven's Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36.

programme.title: Beauty is a Crime: Mendelssohn & Brahms
programme.desc: Greek conductor Teodor Currentzis leads his ensemble MusicAeterna alongside Austrian-Moldovan violinist Patricia Kopatchinskaja in a performance showcasing young, accomplished and energetic musicians.

programme.title: Symphony No. 3, in D minor
programme.desc: The symphony's immense emotional scope, features innovative use of large-scale forces for breathtaking sound, and an ambitious philosophical journey that connects listeners to the grandeur of the natural world.

programme.title: Beethoven: Symphonies and Piano Concerto No. 4
programme.desc: Opening with the composer's Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21; Fischer conducts Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 4 in G major, Op. 58, in which Richard Goode features as the soloist.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Chamber music by Mozart and Shostakovich
programme.desc: French violinist Renaud Capuçon appears at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, presenting a chamber music program consisting of classical and 20th century repertoire. He performs with the soloists of the International Menuhin Music Academy.

programme.title: Sibelius, Mendelssohn & Saariaho
programme.desc: Stephanie Childress leads the LSO in a Northern European concert from LSO St Luke's, featuring works by Sibelius, Mendelssohn and Kaija Saariaho; the evening includes Sibelius's En Saga and Cassazione, Mendelssohn's Violin Concerto.

programme.title: Schumann - Violin Concerto & Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: Violin Concerto in D minor, WoO 23, featuring Dutch violinist Isabelle van Keulen as the soloist; Symphony No. 1 in B-flat major, Op. 38. The concert recording is from Auditorium du Nouveau Siècle in Lille, France, on June 16, 2017.

programme.title: Descent Into the Maelstrom
programme.desc: In the 1980s, Philip Glass creates music for the Australian Dance Theatre based on "Descent into the Maelstrom" by Edgar Allan Poe.

programme.title: Works for Lute by J. S. Bach
